## Testing

- [ ] `bun run check`
- [ ] `bun run check:review-guardrails:staged` (optional fast local pre-commit pass)

## Pre-review guardrails

- [ ] External links with `target="_blank"` include `rel="noopener noreferrer"`.
- [ ] New headings preserve a logical hierarchy and avoid skipped levels.
- [ ] TypeScript changes avoid unnecessary assertions and dead fallback branches.
- [ ] New or renamed files/components follow repository naming conventions.
